entities.summary: Ikechukwu Sean Nwamu is an American-born Nigerian professional basketball player for KB Bashkimi of the Kosovo Basketball Superleague. He has played professionally in the NBA G League and across Europe, including Greece, Israel, Russia, France, Poland, Türkiye, and Kosovo. Nwamu is a 2020 Olympian and a member of the Nigerian national basketball team.
